subject:
**** Request for Quotation – Tender Ref. GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN – 2V 500 Ah VRLA Cells  

**
draft_body:
**  

Dear Sir/Madam,  

**Reference:** Tender GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN  
**Procuring Authority:** Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL)  
**Project Title:** Battery Bank – SITC  

Volks Energie, on behalf of GAIL, hereby invites your esteemed organization, as an **Authorized OEM Partner**, to submit a formal quotation for the supply of the item(s) detailed below.  

---

### 1. Itemized Bill of Quantities (BoQ) & Technical Requirements  

| # | Item Description                | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By Date |
|---|--------------------------------|----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 1 | 2 V 500 Ah VRLA Cells           | 100      | Nos  | IS 15549                 | Visakhapatnam     | 30 Sep 2026      |

---

### 2. Commercial & Delivery Constraints  

- **Delivery Timeline:** 60 days from receipt of purchase order (please specify lead time in weeks/days).  
- **Payment Terms:** 100 % against receipt and acceptance of goods.  

---

### 3. Information Required in Your Quotation  

1. **Unit Price** (exclusive of GST) for each item.  
2. **Lead Time** expressed in weeks and/or days.  
3. **GST Breakdown** (rate applicable and amount per unit).  
4. **Technical Compliance Sheet** confirming conformity with IS 15549 and any additional certifications.  
5. Validity of the quotation (minimum 90 days).  
6. Any applicable freight or handling charges to the delivery location.  

---

### 4. Submission Details  

- **Quotation Deadline:** 15 September 2026 (23:59 IST).  
- **Submission Method:** Email PDF to procurement@volksenergie.in with the subject line “RFQ – GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN – [Your Company Name]”.  
- **Contact for Clarifications:**  
  - Name: [Your Name]  
  - Designation: Procurement Manager – Volks Energie  
  - Phone: +91‑XXXXXXXXXX  
  - Email: procurement@volksenergie.in  

All quotations shall be treated as confidential and will be evaluated solely on technical compliance, price, lead time, and adherence to the stated commercial terms.  

We look forward to receiving your competitive quotation and anticipate a mutually beneficial partnership.  

Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.  

Yours sincerely,  

[Your Name]  
Procurement Manager  
Volks Energie
